title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 457 (Non-disclosure of information in certain cases)

content.overview: The Registrar, or an officer or employee, shall not disclose information obtained in the course of inspection or investigation, except as the section permits.

The Registrar, or an officer or employee, shall not disclose information obtained in the course of inspection or investigation, except as the section permits.
